lines.text: I can feel it rising up inside
This fire burning, I can not keep it quiet
You found me in the corner, overlooked
The one they never gave a second look
Small town, small name, small dreams they said
But something woke up in my chest instead
Everything in me is coming alive
I was made for more than just survive
Everything in me, everything
Is ready to explode
Everything in me, everything
I can not hold it anymore
I am the nobody, the nobody
They never saw me coming
I am the nobody, the nobody
Now watch me while I am running
Everything in me celebrates
I can not hold it in, I will not hold it back
I am the nobody, the nobody
And I am never going back
The proud ones walking tall, so sure
But they do not know what is coming for them
Scattered like leaves when the wind hits hard
The ones who thought they held the cards
The thrones they built are coming down
The small ones rising off the ground
The hungry finally getting fed
The rich left empty-handed instead
Everything in me, everything
Is catching fire now
Everything in me, everything
I can not stop what has started now
I am the nobody, the nobody
They never saw me coming
I am the nobody, the nobody
Now watch me while I am running
I can not hold it in, I will not hold it back
Everything in me celebrates
I am the nobody, the nobody
And I am never going back
You saw me when no one else did
Before I knew what I could be
You picked the small one, the quiet one
And now the world is gonna see
That was never shame
I was nothing, I was no one
It is where the power comes from
We are the nobodies, the nobodies
They never saw us coming
Nothing stays the same
We are the nobodies, the nobodies
Watch us while we are running
Everything in us celebrates
We can not hold it in, we will not hold it back
We are the nobodies, the nobodies
The nobody
The nobody
And we are never going back
Never saw me coming
Finally free
